page.title: Riesling
page.meta_description: Riesling holds acid and site so clearly that tasting-note culture uses it as a lesson in residual sugar versus dry. Related pages: Terroir.
page.content:
Aromatic white of Germany and Alsace, a terroir grape of slate and sweetness scales.

How Riesling connects

  • Topic: Terroir — Riesling is often cited as a grape that broadcasts site and sweetness clearly.

What is Riesling?

Riesling holds acid and site so clearly that tasting-note culture uses it as a lesson in residual sugar versus dry.

Key threads lead to Terroir.
